notes:
{西洋|せいよう} means "the West" - referring to Europe and North America, as contrasted with East Asia.

- {西洋|せいよう}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧: Westerner
- {西洋|せいよう}⟦{風|ふう}→風：noentry⟧: Western-style
- {西洋|せいよう}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: Western cuisine
- {西洋|せいよう}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: Western culture
- {西洋|せいよう}⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧: Western music

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {西洋|せいよう}: the West, Western countries
- ⟦{東洋|とうよう}→東洋：03454_touyou⟧: the East, Eastern countries (Asia)

{西洋|せいよう} often carries connotations of traditional Western culture, while ⟦{欧米|おうべい}→欧米：04112_oubei⟧ is more neutral for modern Western countries.
